name: simzoner
description: Race simulation across US highways on Cloudflare's free tier. `npm run dev` starts all three services at once.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,compute -c cyan,green,magenta "cd frontend && npm run dev -- -p 5199" "cd backend && npx wrangler dev --remote --port 8787" "cd cloud-compute && npx wrangler dev --port 8788"
